recognize_zh: 高倍下是一群核形不規則、N:C 比高、染色質較開放的母細胞樣細胞，細胞質帶嗜酸性顆粒感，其間夾雜含粗大橘紅色顆粒的未成熟嗜酸性球；組織中出現未成熟嗜酸性前驅細胞是提示骨髓性肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma）的重要線索。
features: Atypical blast-like cells with high N:C ratio
Irregular, folded to elongated nuclear contours
Admixed immature eosinophils with coarse orange-red granules
Diffuse discohesive infiltrate with crush/streaming of nuclei
describe_en: High-power examination shows a diffuse infiltrate of atypical blast-like cells with high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratios, irregular nuclear contours and open chromatin. The cytoplasm is eosinophilic and finely granular. Scattered immature eosinophils with coarse eosinophilic granules are admixed. There is no evidence of epithelial differentiation or glandular formation in this field. The findings are suggestive of myeloid sarcoma, to be confirmed by MPO, CD34, CD117 and lysozyme immunostains.

ddx.vs: DLBCL lacks admixed immature eosinophils and granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and is CD20-positive, MPO-negative.
LCH cells have grooved coffee-bean nuclei with abundant pale cytoplasm and are CD1a/langerin-positive, although eosinophils are also prominent.
CHL shows scattered large Reed-Sternberg cells in a polymorphous background rather than sheets of blasts, and is CD30/CD15-positive.
EMH contains trilineage maturing elements including megakaryocytes and erythroid islands rather than sheets of blasts.
